_comment: Model aliases of inhabitant/llm.py. Copy this file to configs/models.json and adjust it. provider: anthropic | openai_responses | openai_chat | gemini. params are provider-native request fields and part of the cache key. Keys come from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY, from the variable named by key_env, or from the file named by key_file. Prices (USD per million tokens) are only used to report the cost of a run; check the providers' price pages, null = not reported.

glm-5.3-flash._note: Any OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. vLLM serving the open weights; set base_url to it (environment variables such as ${VLLM_PORT} are expanded). The server must support tool calls and image input. Thinking is set with reasoning_effort; the reasoning is read from message.reasoning or message.reasoning_content.
